t: You're in King Edward Memorial Park, a public open space in Shadwell, in Tower Hamlets, on the northern bank of the River Thames. It takes its name from Edward the Seventh, who was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from January 1901 until his death in 1910. So the park is a memorial to him, and it gives local people a patch of green beside the river.
